observations: Baseline (Giants.com, 2026-07-15): Nabers is rehabbing the season-ending right-knee ACL/meniscus tear suffered Week 4 of 2025 vs. the Chargers; the coach characterized progress as 'probably maybe 70 percent through... 80 percent through'.

Through the first ~10 camp practices (West Virginia stretch): individual drills and install periods in 9 of the first 10 practices, ramping workload by the end of the trip (Heavy 08-13, citing The Athletic's Dan Duggan).
2026-08-06: first 11-on-11 team-drill participation since the injury — in a light jog-through practice in shells, not a padded/full-speed session (Yahoo, 08-06).

2026-08-12: scheduled workload decrease as part of recovery management; Harbaugh (team-official): 'We're looking towards soon ramping him up into some group periods and perhaps some team periods. Maybe next week.' Earliest possible full-speed group/team entry: Monday 08-17 (Yahoo, 08-13).

Status as of 2026-08-13: still restricted to position drills, not advanced to full-speed group/team periods; will not play in Saturday's (08-15) preseason opener vs. Minnesota; Harbaugh: 'He's kind of exactly where he's been... He's doing great. He's working hard. Spirits are high.' (NJ.com via Yahoo, 08-13).
inferences: Directional mechanism (pre-baseline, preserved as inference): availability trajectory is progressing on a managed ramp; a Week 1 (09-13 vs. Dallas) return is described by reporting as realistic but is a projection, not a completed milestone.
The 08-06 team-drill appearance was a controlled jog-through and is not evidence of full-speed team readiness.
